# Welcome to Jekyll! # # This config file is meant for settings that affect your whole blog, values # which you are expected to set up once and rarely edit after that. # This file is *NOT* reloaded automatically when you use 'bundle exec jekyll serve'. # If you change this file, please restart the server process.
# Site settings # are used to personalize your new site. If you look in the HTML files, # you will see them accessed via {{ site.title }}, {{ site.email }}, and so on. # You can create any custom variable you would like, and they will be accessible # in the templates via {{ site.myvariable }}.
#theme: jekyll-agency remote_theme: raviriley/agency-jekyll-theme
url : "https://www.argitobras.com" # Importante usar https si lo vas a aplicar con Enforce HTTPS en GitHub Pages baseurl: "" # Se deja vacío ("") porque el dominio apuntará a la raíz del sitio (argitobras.com)
title : ARG IT OBRAS | Proyectos y Desarrollos email : contacto@argitobras.com # Usar un email de contacto profesional description: "Portafolio de referencia personal centrado en proyectos, desarrollos y consultoría de IT en Argentina. Expertos en soluciones open-source y escalables." author : Emmanuel M. Ch. # Reemplaza con tu nombre # logo: #optional, defaults to site title # path: assets\img\clients\creative-market.jpg # height: 60 #height in px, defaults to 52px
locale: "es-ES" # See available languages in _data/sitetext.yml
analytics: google: "G-XXXXXXXXXX" #Google Analytics tracking code here
seo: title: "ARG IT OBRAS | Proyectos y Desarrollos" description: "Portafolio de referencia personal centrado en proyectos, desarrollos y consultoría de IT en Argentina. Expertos en soluciones open-source y escalables." keywords: "IT, Argentina, desarrollo software, consultoría, open-source, escalable" author: "Emmanuel M. Ch." image: "https://www.argitobras.com/assets/img/header-bg.jpg" # Imagen para compartir en redes sociales
collections: portfolio:
markdown: kramdown
# Uncomment following line to use Formspree form ID based URL instead of email based URL # Details: https://help.formspree.io/hc/en-us/articles/360017735154-How-to-prevent-spam formspree_form_path: "f/xxxxxxxx" # Details: https://help.formspree.io/hc/en-us/articles/360017735154-How-to-prevent-spam
plugins: - jekyll-remote-theme - jekyll-seo-tag
exclude: - Gemfile - Gemfile.lock - node_modules - vendor/bundle/ - vendor/cache/ - vendor/gems/ - vendor/ruby/
